verdict.rationale: RingCentral offers SMS, so automatic STOP/HELP handling and opt-out suppression is a fair question for this product. The only related evidence is a generic marketing line saying the Business SMS Booster includes 'compliance tools'. That line never mentions STOP/HELP keyword handling or suppressing opted-out contacts, so it is an adjacent claim rather than documented support for this story.

support.subject: As a support leader, STOP and HELP keywords are handled automatically and opted-out contacts are suppressed from future sends
